html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:#030910;color:#edf3f8;font-family:Inter,Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;line-height:1.5;overflow-x:hidden}

footer{border-top:1px solid #182c3c;padding:18px clamp(20px,7vw,110px);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;color:#718595;font-size:9px}footer b{color:#eaf0f7}footer b:first-letter{color:#ff2148}
@media(max-width:1050px){.hero{grid-template-columns:1fr 300px;gap:30px}.hero aside{display:none}.photo{width:280px;height:280px}.cards{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.cards article:first-child{grid-column:1/-1}}
